note: The one place every platform setting is described. Edit it, then run  python tools/gen_settings.py  (see docs/SETTINGS.md).

groups.title: Publishing a site (frontend)
groups.help: How big a student's published site may be, and how long visitors' browsers and the CDN keep it.

groups.title: Student backends
groups.help: The small server-side function each student may publish: its size, memory, time, logs and environment variables.

groups.title: Gateway and rate limits
groups.help: The front door every student backend request passes through: size limits, requests at once, requests per visitor.

groups.title: Sessions and logins
groups.help: How long teacher and student sessions last and when repeated wrong passwords lock a login.

groups.title: Student tokens
groups.help: How long a token can live and what happens when it runs out.

groups.title: Class AI
groups.help: The AI connector: spending cap range, default model, answer size and time.

groups.title: Student storage
groups.help: The small database and file area a student's backend may use.

groups.title: Class knowledge (books)
groups.help: Books a student's backend can search: caps per student and for the class library, reading limits, search rules.

groups.title: Background jobs
groups.help: Work that runs after the request has answered.

groups.title: Traces
groups.help: The step-by-step record of answers: what is kept, for how long, and the drift alerts.

groups.title: Project sync
groups.help: Students' source files kept on the platform: sizes, counts, history.

groups.title: Worker machine (optional)
groups.help: The optional small EC2 machine for platform-owned checks.

groups.title: Alerts and monitoring
groups.help: When the platform tells the teacher something is wrong.

groups.title: API request throttles
groups.help: How many requests per second each platform API accepts.

groups.title: Platform functions
groups.help: Memory and time of the platform's own functions.

groups.title: Stored files and clean-up
groups.help: How long the platform keeps leftovers.

groups.title: Feature switches
groups.help: Which optional parts of the platform exist at all. Off by default; with a feature off nothing about it is created.

groups.title: Installation (set by the installer)
groups.help: Names and ids the installer fills in. Normally changed only with the install and domain commands.

settings.title: Largest upload (zip)
settings.help: The biggest zip file a student may publish as their site. Bigger sites are refused with a clear message.

settings.title: Largest site once unpacked
settings.help: The total size of all files in a published site after unzipping. Protects against zip bombs and storage growth.
settings.cost: Raising it raises S3 storage and CloudFront transfer.

settings.title: Most files in a site
settings.help: The number of files in one published site.

settings.title: How long the CDN keeps a file
settings.help: CloudFront keeps a file at most this long. A publish clears it at once, so this only matters if that clearing ever fails.

settings.title: Largest backend upload (zip)
settings.help: The biggest zip a student may publish as their backend. AWS allows at most 50 MB zipped (and 250 MB unzipped) for a function.

settings.title: Largest backend once unpacked
settings.help: Total size of a backend's files after unzipping. AWS itself allows at most 250 MB.

settings.title: Most files in a backend
settings.help: The number of files in one backend upload.

settings.title: Memory of a student's backend
settings.help: The memory each student backend function is given when it is published (applies to backends published after the change). AWS accounts start with a cap of 3,008 MB per function (this account was checked); a quota increase raises it.
settings.cost: Memory is billed per second of running time; double the memory is about double the cost per request.

settings.title: Time a backend request may take
settings.help: How long one backend request may run before it is stopped. AWS's HTTP front door ends every request at 30 seconds; the platform keeps 2 seconds of margin for the hop through its gateway, so 27 is the highest safe value.
settings.cost: Longer requests cost more and hold platform capacity longer.

settings.title: How long backend logs are kept
settings.help: Days a student backend's log lines stay available (the logs command and the teacher view).
settings.cost: Logs are billed per stored GB.

settings.title: Backend runs allowance
settings.help: Default runs allowance a student gets when the teacher enables the backend (maximum a teacher may set is the upper range).
settings.cost: Each run costs a small amount of Lambda time.

settings.title: Most environment variables
settings.help: How many environment variables a student may set on their backend.

settings.title: Size of all environment variables
settings.help: Total size of a backend's environment variables. AWS allows at most 4096 bytes.

settings.title: Log lines returned
settings.help: Default and largest number of log lines returned by one logs request.

settings.title: Log look-back window
settings.help: Default and largest number of minutes of log history one request looks at.

settings.title: Log events read per page
settings.help: Events read from the log service in one call (up to pages x this many are read, then the newest are kept).

settings.title: Log pages read
settings.help: How many pages of log events one logs request reads.

settings.title: Longest log message
settings.help: A longer message keeps its end (the real error is at the end of a traceback).

settings.title: Shortest environment value that is masked
settings.help: An environment variable value shorter than this is not hidden in logs (too many false hits).

settings.title: Reserved concurrency per student backend
settings.help: 0 means none. On a new AWS account the limit is 10 so nothing can be reserved; the gateway's request limits protect the account instead.

settings.title: Largest request body
settings.help: The biggest request a visitor may send to a student's backend.

settings.title: Largest response
settings.help: The biggest answer a student backend may return. AWS functions can return at most about 6 MB.

settings.title: When a stuck request counter is freed
settings.help: A requests-in-flight counter untouched this long while above zero is treated as leaked and reset.

settings.title: Requests per visitor per minute
settings.help: How many requests one visitor address may send to student backends per minute.

settings.title: Requests at once, whole platform
settings.help: Student backend requests that may run at the same time on the whole platform. The installer sets it from your AWS account's real Lambda concurrency limit (see Capacity).
settings.note: Derived from the AWS Lambda concurrency quota by the installer.

settings.title: Requests at once, per student
settings.help: Student backend requests that may run at once for one student.
settings.note: Derived from the AWS Lambda concurrency quota by the installer.

settings.title: How long a busy request waits
settings.help: When every slot is busy, how long the gateway waits for one to free up before answering busy. 0 answers at once.
settings.note: Derived from the AWS Lambda concurrency quota by the installer.

settings.title: How long a backend lookup is remembered
settings.help: The gateway remembers which backend belongs to a site for this long.

settings.title: How long a missing backend is remembered
settings.help: How long the gateway remembers that a site has no backend.

settings.title: Teacher session length
settings.help: How long a teacher stays signed in.

settings.title: Student session length
settings.help: How long a student stays signed in to the student page.

settings.title: Wrong passwords before a lock
settings.help: After this many wrong teacher passwords in a row the login is locked.

settings.title: How long a lock lasts
settings.help: How long the login stays locked after too many wrong passwords.

settings.title: Longest token life
settings.help: The most days a student token can be valid when it is created or renewed.

settings.title: Days a site keeps working offline
settings.help: After a token expires, how many days the student's site and backend keep working before they go offline.

settings.title: Days of warning before a token expires
settings.help: How many days before expiry the student is warned.

settings.title: Default AI spending cap per student
settings.help: The cap a student gets when the teacher turns the class AI on for them. The lowest and highest cap a teacher can set for one student are this setting's range.
settings.cost: This is real money per student per period.

settings.title: Default AI model
settings.help: The model a student gets when the teacher does not choose one.
settings.cost: Models differ a lot in price.

settings.title: How often the student page refreshes usage
settings.help: The student page asks for AI usage at most this often.

settings.title: Time an AI answer may take
settings.help: How long a student's backend may wait for the AI. The front door stops at 29 seconds.

settings.title: Typical cost of one AI call
settings.help: Used to estimate how many calls a cap allows when showing a student their allowance.

settings.title: Answer length of the Gemini proxy
settings.help: Default and largest number of answer tokens one request may ask for through the Gemini proxy.
settings.cost: Longer answers cost more.

settings.title: Largest request to the Gemini proxy
settings.help: The biggest request body the Gemini proxy accepts.

settings.title: How long AI provider keys are remembered
settings.help: A function remembers a provider key it read from the secret store for this long.

settings.title: Largest stored value
settings.help: The biggest single item a student may save in the class database.

settings.title: Most items in one collection
settings.help: The number of items one collection may hold.

settings.title: Largest stored file
settings.help: The biggest single file a student may save.

settings.title: Most stored files
settings.help: The number of files one student may keep.

settings.title: Most collection names
settings.help: How many different collection names a student may ever use (each is remembered so the teacher can clear them).

settings.title: Database space per student
settings.help: Default database space a student gets; the upper range is the most a teacher may give one student.
settings.cost: Stored data is billed per GB-month.

settings.title: File space per student
settings.help: Default file space a student gets; the upper range is the most a teacher may give one student.
settings.cost: Stored files are billed per GB-month.

settings.title: Storage operations allowance
settings.help: Default number of storage operations per period a student gets; the upper range is the most a teacher may give.
settings.cost: Each operation costs a small amount.

settings.title: Items per list page
settings.help: How many items one list request returns.

settings.title: Size of a list page
settings.help: A list answer stays below this size (AWS allows 6 MB per answer).

settings.title: Upload link life
settings.help: How long a file upload link stays valid.

settings.title: Download link life
settings.help: How long a file download link stays valid.

settings.title: How long a function trusts its own memory
settings.help: A warm function remembers a collection list for this long, so one deleted elsewhere is rebuilt within a minute.

settings.title: Shelves per student
settings.help: Default number of shelves a student gets; the upper range is the most a teacher may give one student.

settings.title: Books per student
settings.help: Default number of books a student gets; the upper range is the most a teacher may give.

settings.title: Passages per student
settings.help: Default number of searchable passages a student's books may produce.
settings.cost: Passages are stored and searched; more passages cost more to read and keep.

settings.title: Book space per student
settings.help: Default storage for a student's books.
settings.cost: Stored books are billed per GB-month.

settings.title: Largest book per student
settings.help: Default size limit of one book a student uploads.

settings.title: Searches allowance
settings.help: Default searches per period a student gets.
settings.cost: Each search of meaning uses a small amount of embedding cost.

settings.title: Searches period
settings.help: The period the searches allowance counts over (day, month or total).

settings.title: Reading allowance (embedding tokens)
settings.help: Default amount of text, in tokens, a student's books may have turned into search data.
settings.cost: Embedding is billed per million tokens.

settings.title: Class library: shelves
settings.help: Most shelves the shared class library may have (teacher only).

settings.title: Class library: books
settings.help: Most books the class library may hold.

settings.title: Class library: passages
settings.help: Most passages the class library may hold.

settings.title: Class library: space
settings.help: Storage of the class library.
settings.cost: Stored books are billed per GB-month.

settings.title: Class library: largest book
settings.help: Largest book the teacher may add to the class library.

settings.title: Shelves in one search
settings.help: How many shelves one search may name.

settings.title: Most passages returned by one search
settings.help: The largest number of passages a search may ask for.

settings.title: Longest search question
settings.help: The longest question a search accepts.

settings.title: Book upload link life
settings.help: How long a book upload link stays valid.

settings.title: When an unused upload is forgotten
settings.help: An upload form nobody used is forgotten (and its book slot freed) after this long.

settings.title: When unfinished reading is failed
settings.help: Work that has not finished long after the worker's own time limit is marked failed.

settings.title: How long search data is cached
settings.help: Days a computed search vector is reused instead of being bought again.
settings.cost: A shorter time means more embedding cost.

settings.title: Largest knowledge API request
settings.help: The biggest request the knowledge API accepts from a student's backend.

settings.title: Steps an app may report per search
settings.help: How many trace steps an app may report along with one search.

settings.title: Largest book the reader accepts
settings.help: The largest file the book reader will process.

settings.title: Most pages in a book
settings.help: A book with more pages is refused.

settings.title: Most passages in a book
settings.help: A book that would produce more passages is refused.

settings.title: Smallest real PDF page
settings.help: A PDF page with fewer characters than this is treated as a scan with no text.

settings.title: Size of a pseudo-page
settings.help: Text, Markdown and HTML have no pages, so they are cut into pieces of about this size for citing.

settings.title: Shelves kept in memory
settings.help: How many shelves one warm search function keeps in memory.

settings.title: Passages kept in memory
settings.help: Never more passages than this are kept in memory in total.

settings.title: Tries to rebuild a search index
settings.help: How often a failed rebuild is retried before giving up.

settings.title: Meaning match needed to answer
settings.help: How close in meaning the best passage must be for the books to answer. Higher means the app says it does not know more often.
settings.note: A starting point; calibrate per shelf from an evaluation set on real books.

settings.title: Word match needed to answer
settings.help: Share of the question's words the best passage must contain for the books to answer.
settings.note: A starting point; calibrate per shelf from an evaluation set on real books.

settings.title: Texts per embedding request
settings.help: How many passages are sent to the embedding service at once (Google accepts 100).

settings.title: Longest text to embed
settings.help: About 3000 tokens; a passage is far smaller, so anything bigger is a mistake upstream.

settings.title: Book readers at once
settings.help: How many books may be read at the same time on the whole platform.
settings.cost: Each reader holds a function execution for minutes.

settings.title: Monthly embedding budget
settings.help: The most the whole platform spends per month on turning books and questions into search data.
settings.cost: This is real money per month.

settings.title: Embedding model
settings.help: The model that turns text into search data. Changing it means every book must be read again.

settings.title: Embedding size
settings.help: The number of numbers per passage. Changing it means every book must be read again. The upper range is the model's limit.

settings.title: Background jobs per day
settings.help: Default jobs per day a student gets; the upper range is the most a teacher may give.
settings.cost: Each job holds a function for minutes.

settings.title: Jobs at once per student
settings.help: Default number of jobs one student may run at once; the upper range is the most a teacher may give.

settings.title: Minutes a job may run
settings.help: Default minutes one job may run; the upper range is the most a teacher may give. AWS stops any function at 15 minutes.
settings.cost: Longer jobs cost more.

settings.title: Largest job result
settings.help: The biggest result a job may save.

settings.title: Largest job input
settings.help: The biggest input a job may be started with.

settings.title: Jobs per list
settings.help: How many jobs one list request returns.

settings.title: When a silent job is failed
settings.help: A job that has not reported for this long past its time limit is marked failed.

settings.title: Jobs at once, whole platform
settings.help: Jobs that may run at once on the whole platform. Each holds a function execution for minutes, and a new AWS account allows only 10.

settings.title: Default trace retention
settings.help: Default days a trace is kept before it is deleted automatically. The choices are 30, 60 or 90.

settings.title: Traces per day per student
settings.help: Default number of traces a student's app may record per day; the upper range is the most a teacher may give.
settings.cost: Each trace is stored in the database.

settings.title: Longest stored text
settings.help: One stored text value is cut to this length.

settings.title: Largest stored step
settings.help: A stored step stays far below the database's 400 KB item limit.

settings.title: Most details per step
settings.help: How many named details one step may carry.

settings.title: Longest short detail
settings.help: A short detail kept even at the lowest privacy level is cut to this length.

settings.title: Most steps in one trace
settings.help: How many steps one trace may hold.

settings.title: Steps allowed per trace
settings.help: An app may report this many steps per allowed trace per day (daily limit times this), counted atomically.

settings.title: Traces removed per call
settings.help: Traces removed per call of delete all of a student's traces (the teacher page repeats until done).

settings.title: Days between retention reminders
settings.help: How often the teacher is reminded to download or clear old traces.

settings.title: Traces per download page
settings.help: How many traces one page of a download holds (AWS allows 6 MB per answer).

settings.title: Size of a download page
settings.help: The size of one page of a trace download.

settings.title: How long daily summaries are kept
settings.help: Days the per-day summaries (counts, cost, refusals) are kept.

settings.title: Answers needed to judge a rate
settings.help: A rate over fewer answers than this says nothing, so no alert is raised.

settings.title: Rise in refusals that raises an alert
settings.help: Alert when the share of the books do not say answers is this much above last week's.

settings.title: Error share that raises an alert
settings.help: Alert when this share of answers had an error.

settings.title: Days of history for the baseline
settings.help: How many past days the usual rates are computed from.

settings.title: Most files in a project
settings.help: The number of files a synced project may hold.

settings.title: Largest project file
settings.help: The biggest single file in a synced project.

settings.title: Project size now
settings.help: What a project may hold right now.
settings.cost: Stored files are billed per GB-month.

settings.title: Everything ever stored for a project
settings.help: Everything ever uploaded to a project; old versions stay until the teacher compacts it.
settings.cost: Stored files are billed per GB-month.

settings.title: Paths in one push
settings.help: How many file changes one push may carry.

settings.title: Members of a team project
settings.help: How many students a team project may have.

settings.title: How long project history is kept
settings.help: Days each earlier version stays listed so it can be put back.

settings.title: Project upload link life
settings.help: How long an upload link for project files stays valid.

settings.title: Project download link life
settings.help: How long a download link for project files stays valid.

settings.title: Tries when two people push at once
settings.help: How often a push is retried when someone else's push lands first.

settings.title: Monthly machine minutes (class cap)
settings.help: The most minutes the worker machine may run per month for the whole class. The range is the lowest and highest cap a teacher may set.
settings.cost: The machine is billed per second while it runs.

settings.title: Longest single run
settings.help: The longest one run of the worker machine may last; a watchdog stops it after this. The range is the lowest and highest value allowed.
settings.cost: Longer runs cost more.

settings.title: Machine size
settings.help: The size of the worker machine. The default is one a Free plan AWS account may use; the c7g sizes need a paid plan.
settings.cost: Bigger machines cost more per hour.

settings.title: Machine disk
settings.help: Disk size of the worker machine. The disk is billed all month, even when the machine is off.
settings.cost: About 8 cents per GB per month.

settings.title: Machine image
settings.help: The machine image the installer picked (x86 or ARM). Filled in by the installer.

settings.title: Concurrency alarm level
settings.help: The alarm fires when this many function executions run at once (your AWS account limit is the ceiling).

settings.title: Alert address (parameter name)
settings.help: The name of the AWS parameter that holds the e-mail address for alerts. The address itself stays in AWS. Empty means no alerts.

settings.title: Backend API: requests per second
settings.help: Steady requests per second the student backend API accepts. The installer sets it from the account's concurrency limit.
settings.note: Derived from the AWS Lambda concurrency quota by the installer.

settings.title: Backend API: burst
settings.help: Short burst of requests the student backend API accepts.
settings.note: Derived from the AWS Lambda concurrency quota by the installer.

settings.title: Deploy API: requests per second
settings.help: Steady requests per second the portal and deploy API accept.

settings.title: Deploy API: burst
settings.help: Short burst the portal and deploy API accept.

settings.title: Storage API: requests per second
settings.help: Steady requests per second the class storage API accepts.

settings.title: Storage API: burst
settings.help: Short burst the class storage API accepts.

settings.title: Portal function memory
settings.help: Memory of the function that serves the portal and the deploy API.
settings.cost: Billed per second of running time.

settings.title: Portal function time limit
settings.help: Time limit of the portal function. The API front door stops at 29 seconds.

settings.title: Gateway function memory
settings.help: Memory of the gateway function.
settings.cost: Billed per second of running time.

settings.title: Gateway function time limit
settings.help: Time limit of the gateway function. The API front door stops at 29 seconds.

settings.title: Storage function memory
settings.help: Memory of the class storage function.

settings.title: Storage function time limit
settings.help: Time limit of the class storage function.

settings.title: Nightly clean-up memory
settings.help: Memory of the nightly clean-up function.

settings.title: Nightly clean-up time limit
settings.help: Time limit of the nightly clean-up function.

settings.title: Nightly clean-up time
settings.help: When the nightly clean-up runs (AWS cron format, in UTC).

settings.title: Days an upload zip is kept
settings.help: Uploaded zip files are deleted after this many days.

settings.title: Days an old file version is kept
settings.help: Replaced or deleted file versions are kept this many days so a mistake can be undone.
settings.cost: Old versions are billed as storage.

settings.title: Student backends
settings.help: Turns on student backends, the gateway and the /api route. Off creates and changes nothing about backends.

settings.title: Class AI connector
settings.help: Lets the teacher give a student's backend a capped, revocable AI key. Needs student backends.

settings.title: Google Gemini for the class AI
settings.help: Lets the teacher give a student Google Gemini instead of OpenRouter. Needs the class AI.

settings.title: Class storage connector
settings.help: Gives students' backends a small database and file area with hard caps. Needs student backends.

settings.title: Class knowledge connector
settings.help: Gives students' backends searchable books, and the class one shared library. Needs student backends.

settings.title: Traces
settings.help: A step-by-step record of answers, stored per student and deleted automatically. Needs student backends.

settings.title: Compute worker
settings.help: One small machine that is off by default, for platform-owned checks. With it off nothing is created.
settings.cost: A few dollars a month when used.

settings.title: Platform domain
settings.help: The domain student sites are served from (for example apps.example.com). Empty serves them from the CDN address instead.

settings.title: Certificate
settings.help: The certificate for the platform domain (must be in us-east-1). Required when a domain is set.

settings.title: Portal address on the domain
settings.help: Attaches deploy.<domain> to the portal. Keep false on the first install until the DNS record exists.

settings.title: Parameter holding the signing keys
settings.help: The name of the AWS parameter that holds the students' access keys.

settings.title: Parameter holding the teacher password
settings.help: The name of the AWS parameter that holds the teacher's password hash.

settings.title: Custom-domain distribution
settings.help: The CloudFront multi-tenant distribution used for students' own domains. Empty switches the custom-domain feature off.

settings.title: Custom-domain routing endpoint
settings.help: The routing endpoint of the custom-domain pieces. Filled in by the installer.

settings.title: Custom-domain connection group
settings.help: The CloudFront connection group the student domains join. Empty uses the default one.

settings.title: Secret holding the AI keys
settings.help: The name of the AWS secret that holds the OpenRouter management key and the Google key.

settings.title: Parameter holding the Google sign-in setting
settings.help: The name of the AWS parameter (SecureString) that holds the Google client id and secret for sign-in in student apps. The teacher stores it once.

fixed.reason: Unit conversion (one US dollar is a million micro-dollars), not a choice.
Unit conversion (seconds in a day), not a choice.
Unit conversion (bytes in a megabyte), not a choice.
Unit conversion (bytes in a megabyte), not a choice.
Unit conversion (bytes in a megabyte), not a choice.
Unit conversion (milliseconds in a second), not a choice.
Derived: twice the largest stored value (storage.maxValueKB), so it follows that setting.
The back-off schedule (1, 2 and 4 seconds) for a failing embedding call: a design choice, not a limit.
A price table for embedding models: facts from the providers, kept in code (or in the EMBEDDING_PRICES environment variable).
A price table for Gemini models: facts from the provider, kept in code (or in the AI_GEMINI_PRICES environment variable).
AWS hourly prices of the worker machine sizes: facts from AWS.
The AWS price of a disk per GB and month: a fact from AWS.
The 24 hours of a day (the daily start hour choices): not a choice.
The retention choices the teacher page offers (30, 60 or 90 days): the values the format allows. The default is traces.retentionDays.
